items.title: Mittag-Leffler in the first term makes a sequence of limits exact
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in an exact sequence of inverse systems of abelian groups whose first term satisfies the Mittag-Leffler condition, the induced sequence of limits is exact in the middle (statement lines 7916-7928). The proof is a complete argument: the kernel and image systems are introduced and identified with the kernel of the limit map (proof lines 7930-7936), the image system inherits the Mittag-Leffler property as a quotient of the first system (proof lines 7937-7938), and the limit statement applied to the displayed short exact sequence gives surjectivity onto the kernel of the limit map, which is the claimed exactness (proof lines 7939-7942). The non-formal content is the arrangement of the two short exact sequences. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
